claims.source_quote_ar: وَيَجُوزُ أَنْ تَكُونَ «مَا» نَافِيَةً، وَأَنْ تَكُونَ اسْتِفْهَامًا.
claims.claim_ar: يجوز أن تكون «ما» نافية، وأن تكون استفهامًا
claims.claim_en: The particle "ما" may be analyzed either as a negating particle or as an interrogative.
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited remark in al-Tibyan discusses 'ما' in the context of a different phrase ('ما أغنى'); its application to 'وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا' is a generalization rather than an explicit commentary on this specific verse.

warnings: Most provided source chunks do not treat S7:94 specifically; only the chunk about the particle «ما» was applicable and was generalized to this verse.
